stem.text: A water wave is diffracted as it passes through a gap between two barriers in a ripple tank. The wave is observed to ‘spread out’ as it moves through the gap.
Which two factors both affect the amount of diffraction observed?

A.text: the amplitude and frequency of the incident wave

B.text: the amplitude of the incident wave and the width of the gap

C.text: the wavelength and amplitude of the incident wave

D.text: the wavelength of the incident wave and the width of the gap
